description: Phonons on a 2x2x2 supercell: relax -> phonopy init + finite-displacement forces -> phonopy FORCE_CONSTANTS -> phonond. The force evaluation is 2x2x2 x 2 atoms = 16 atoms, one IBRION=8 run per displaced atom.

stages.note: Phonons need a much tighter EDIFFG than a geometry screening: -0.001 eV/A, not -0.01.

-phonon takes named options (--dim 3|2|1, --vac N, --chain N, --n POINTS, --out FILE), never a positional argument: 'qvasp -phonon 2 2 2' is read as 'use the file named 2'. Defaults are 3D and 51 points per segment.

phonopy-init vasp -c POSCAR --dim "2 2 2" writes disp-*/; submit one IBRION=8 VASP run in each of them, then phonopy-init -f disp-*/vasprun.xml. The tool stops here because phonopy is not a qvasp command.
phonopy --dim "2 2 2" --fc-symmetry writes FORCE_CONSTANTS. Run it here, then call workflow_resume.
